title: Can this become a release?
prompt: A shared notebook contains many successful runs. What should happen next?
hint: The community pipeline is a review process, not a popularity threshold.

options.text: Automatically mark the conjecture proved after enough team members approve.
Preserve the parameters and failures, label the evidence, formulate a candidate claim, and seek explicit mathematical verification before a release.
Delete runs that did not finish to make the result clearer.

feedback.pass: Preserve → formulate → review → verify → release. Account state cannot grant mathematical authority.
feedback.fail: Neither popularity nor removing failures changes the scope of a finite experiment.
